class.description: `WFCSolverNode`: SceneTree WFC solver node extending `ProceduralGenerationHost` , solving whole-game configurations, scene hierarchies (`CastleGrounds -> CastleTower -> children`), and 2D/3D/hypergraph slot topologies. Part of IdeamWaveFunctionCollapse (WFC rule tensors, scene analyzers, and constraint solvers).
